en.t: Why can you not feel at ease?"

units.source_text: 就把这诗送给背转身子坐在纸隔扇后面的一个侍女看。

en.t: Then he showed this poem to a maidservant who was sitting behind the paper screen with her back turned.

units.source_text: 这侍女身子也不转过来，从容不迫地振笔疾书道：

en.t: The maidservant did not turn around either, but calmly took up her brush and swiftly wrote:
